member.name: T:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree
member.summary: A single-threaded persistent layout forest. Storage grows only on creation/Reserve. Geometry is parent-local. GetWorldRect composes origins without walking unchanged descendants.

member.name: T:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.MeasureCache
member.summary: The four most recent measurements of one node. A node is commonly measured under a handful of constraints per pass (natural, then forced main and/or cross), so keeping the last few avoids re-running content callbacks within a single layout.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.GetContentRect(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: The area inside a node's padding, relative to the node's own top left. This is where measured content such as text belongs, since it was measured to fit exactly this size.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.SetStyle(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId,Prowl.Scaffold.Style@)
member.summary: Exact value comparison: declaring an identical style does not invalidate layout.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.SetMeasure(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId,Prowl.Scaffold.MeasureContent,System.Object)
member.summary: Register the intrinsic measurement for a node. Always invalidates: the context is opaque, so re-declaring is the caller saying the content may have moved. Register once and use for updates if you want to keep a node's measurement cached.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.Detach(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: Turn a subtree into a root without destroying its nodes or cached geometry.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.MarkSubtreeDirty(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: Invalidate every measurement in a subtree, e.g. after a global font/DPI change. Visits the subtree once, then propagates through its ancestors once.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.PlaceAfter(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId,Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId,Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: Move a subtree, or reorder it immediately after a sibling. Default after means first.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.Remove(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: Remove a subtree and invalidate every handle into it.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.Layout(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId,Prowl.Scaffold.Size)
member.summary: Lay out a root into an exact viewport. Clean repeated calls are O(1). Root width/height are overridden by the viewport. Padding and child layout still apply.

member.summary: Size bounds take pixels and percentages. Intrinsic content and flex weights are properties of a size, not of a limit on one.

member.name: M:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.GetSubtreeCount(Prowl.Scaffold.NodeId)
member.summary: Count this node and all its descendants in O(subtree size).

member.summary: Copy a subtree in parent-first hierarchy order to caller-owned storage. Returns entries written, including hidden nodes (zero rectangles). O(subtree size + depth), zero allocations. An undersized destination throws before writing anything. Call after successful Layout. Sibling order follows the tree, unaffected by Style.Reverse.

member.name: T:Prowl.Scaffold.LayoutTree.Resolved
member.summary: A style with its percentage-bearing lengths collapsed against a known available size. Everything else passes straight through to the declared style.
